notes.title: New title drop!
notes.content:
[h3]The team behind WET VR have just dropped another title: [b]HIT[/b]![/h3][h3][b]Check it out and grab the limited-time launch sale![/b][/h3][p]
[b]What is HIT?[/b][/p][p][b]It's the ultimate stress-buster! [/b]Take out your stress by pummelling, slapping, and whacking squishy clay heads. Thanks to the wild soft body physics, every hit deforms and reshapes the heads in hilariously unpredictable ways![/p][p][/p][p]⭐ Over 1,800 5-star reviews on the Quest store(!), this is what people are saying:[/p][p][/p][p]"Fun game to get your anger out no bugs just fun..." - Meta Quest store review[/p][p]"W game - This games amazing! Also I love how they say different voice lines" - Meta Quest store review[/p][p]"Great game - I had a lot of fun playing this game but I hit my hand on the wall" - Meta Quest store review[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555410/HIT/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Happy hitting! 👊[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
